question: INSV Kaundinya arrived in Muscat after its maiden voyage from Porbandar to celebrate 5,000 years of maritime heritage between India and which country?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Oman.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **INSV Kaundinya arrived in Muscat after its maiden voyage from Porbandar, celebrating 5,000 years of India–Oman maritime heritage.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **INSV Kaundinya completed its maiden voyage from Porbandar to Muscat.**
 
• The voyage commemorated 5,000 years of maritime heritage between India and Oman.
 
• The arrival also marked 70 years of diplomatic relations between the two countries.
 
• The initiative highlights historical maritime links and cultural exchanges between India and Oman.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• INSV Kaundinya__

 __
 
• A traditionally stitched sail vessel inspired by ancient Indian shipbuilding techniques.
 
• Designed based on depictions from Ajanta paintings.
 
 
 
• India–Oman Relations__
 __
 
• Both nations share over 5,000 years of maritime trade and cultural connections.
 
• Diplomatic relations between India and Oman were established 70 years ago.
 
 
 
• Maritime Heritage MoU__
 
 
• An MoU was signed to promote cooperation in maritime heritage and museums.
 
• Aims to strengthen bilateral ties through cultural and historical collaboration.
